notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
I feel compelled to inform you that we have encountered a minor issue with the VENTURA MAC Version. Specifically, a single video does not play. For some reason only the audio runs :(
If we can't fix this before release, I was thinking of inserting a folder dedicated to Ventura users in the game download, where I will insert a simple MP4 of the video in question. It's just an idea but it seemed fair of me to inform you of this.
Please know that the video does not affect the gameplay in ANY WAY.
There are here VENTURA users? Do you have any ideas?
However, I can 100% confirm that this problem will not recur in subsequent Chapters of the game.
Thanks for your attention.
